hearing.quote: Fruitvale gets the briefing and the written record before expansion, not the other way around.
hearing.actionAsked: Hold expansion; require execution and publication of the D3 Fruitvale briefing record with the actual date, venue, notice dates, accessibility and participation arrangements, and the district and Fruitvale data references, and file written next dates for the D5 audit and Baylight feasibility review.

hearing.quote: West Oakland gets a verified closeout and a faithful charter renewal — not a shortcut around the businesses and residents this fund serves.
hearing.actionAsked: Hold the C114 closeout verification and Council charter-renewal consideration on this cycle's calendar; no renewal claimed before verification and Council action, with business-and-resident scope and the 23-day standard preserved.

hearing.quote: A floor vote is an individual position, not an enacted law; District 8 votes yes strictly under Chen-Vega oversight, but only a certified roll call makes it real.
hearing.actionAsked: Vote YES on the full-council roll call with Chen-Vega milestone and audit conditions intact, withholding any claim of enactment until certification by the City Clerk.

hearing.quote: East Oakland's calls are already inside this program. We do not get expanded into more of a thing we cannot read the record of.
hearing.actionAsked: Execute and publish the D3 Fruitvale briefing record and file a written next date for the D5 audit and Baylight feasibility review this cycle; expansion held until all three records are public.

hearing.quote: A review is not a pass; the evidence has to earn that conclusion.
hearing.actionAsked: Conduct and publish the evidence-file review; declare no milestone pass without supporting evidence and continue oversight.

hearing.quote: An isolated health spike demands disciplined departmental follow-through and prompt facts for our residents, not administrative panic or unneeded bureaucracy.
hearing.actionAsked: Direct the responsible public health authorities to publish an evidence-based update and schedule a public briefing on the Piedmont Avenue health spike without creating new administrative bureaucracy.

hearing.quote: The Fund was never hood-wide relief, and it was never housing — it is West Oakland businesses and neighbors, with the 23-day clock kept honest. I verified nothing by wishing it.
hearing.actionAsked: Vote YES on Council charter-renewal consideration, contingent on verified C114 closeout, with business-and-resident scope and the 23-day standard preserved.

hearing.quote: Clinical dollars require clinical proof; an operating facility does not get an exemption from delivering its quarterly audit data.
hearing.actionAsked: Transmit Q3 intake audit to HCAI and Council Clerk and submit verified Telegraph & 47th merchant walkthrough report.

hearing.quote: A filed ordinance deserves a hearing on its own record, not confusion with two different proposals.
hearing.actionAsked: Refer the filed INIT-011 ordinance to committee and hold the hearing, preserving distinct records for the three Ivy Hill initiatives.
